about_the_game:
TomoJam

Play music your way with nothing but a game controller.

TomoJam turns your controller into a real instrument. Jam solo or form a chaotic four-player band on the couch as you perform real MIDI songs with surprising musical depth.

Play, Jam, and Laugh

Every direction on your D-pad and face buttons corresponds to real notes. Use shoulder buttons to shift or sharpen notes, and the game automatically adapts to each song, no matter how many octaves it spans. It’s expressive, intuitive, and hilariously fun when your friends hit the wrong note.

Choose Your Challenge

TomoJam scales with your skill level. Amateur mode keeps it simple with just two notes, great for jumping in. Pro opens up the full layout without sharps or octaves, and Master brings the full experience where every note counts. You can also slow down or speed up songs to practice tricky parts or turn mellow tunes into high-speed chaos.

A Musical Sandbox

TomoJam includes a library of public-domain MIDI tracks (plus a few originals), but the real magic starts when you add your own. Drop in any MIDI file and start playing, no setup, no editing, just pure creative freedom.

Play Alone or Together

Jam solo or with up to four players locally. Online play is coming during Early Access, so you’ll soon be able to share your performances from anywhere.

Learn, Create, Experiment

The note charts mirror real musical notation, helping you learn while you play. Every note you hit, or miss, rings out in real time, turning every session into equal parts concert and comedy.

name: Tomo Jam
short_description: TomoJam is a musical sandbox where up to 4 players can perform real MIDI songs using only their gamepads. Play, learn, and laugh as you hit (and miss) every note solo or together. Add your own MIDI files and explore a surprisingly deep, endlessly customizable way to make music and Jam with friends!
